_doc: ONI TETSUBO — MK FINAL playable #1. New character, no prior ledger. Raws untracked in qa-boss/raw/.
source: input/MK FINAL/ (mythic). PLAYABLE character — wires into the charSelect roster like gorvak/volta, NOT a campaign node. Do not touch fightCampaign.ts.
anchor: qa-boss/anchors/mk/oni-tetsubo-anchor-green.png (PADDED via pad-anchor-plate.mjs; raw art was L51/R28/T71)
frame_budget: L234 / R234 / HEADROOM 468. PROP-EXTENDED: body mass only 401px wide (x279..x679), tetsubo hangs 622px past the body. Workable only because padding gives 234px past the club tip vs satoshi's 48px.
KIT_STATUS: 3/13 accepted. victory v1 REJECTED (front turn + vertical club); v2 written and gate-clean, NOT yet fired.

idle.spec: seedance_2_0, 4s, 720p, std, bitrate standard, 1:1, audio off, plate as start_image + end_image, use_unlim (0 credits)

measured.minIoU_vs_f0: 0.916 @f95 (real subtle motion — a frozen clip reads ~1.000)

idle.verdict: ACCEPT — this clip DEFINES the kit anchor
idle.qa: PASS. On-model, strict side profile facing screen-right, tetsubo held at the reference angle, containment clean on every counted edge. minIoU 0.916 confirms real subtle idle motion rather than a frozen frame — the defect-gates-converge-on-boring failure. The padded plate is doing its job: zero containment overrun on a PROP-EXTENDED character, which is exactly what the raw art could never have achieved.
idle.anchor_note: The kit anchor IS this clip's f0, not the plate. So its 0.926-vs-plate is informational; what matters for the other 12 clips is that they return to THIS f0.
idle.residual: Loop f0-vs-fLast 0.917 — a small pop each time the idle repeats. Accepted for now because it does not block building the kit. A v2 should add an explicit final-second-motionless beat. Compare: session peers hit 0.925-0.930 on anchor-lock.

hit.spec: seedance_2_0, 4s, 720p, std, bitrate standard, 1:1, audio off, plate as start_image + end_image, use_unlim (0 credits)

measured.reference: THE KIT ANCHOR = idle v1 f0 (not the plate)
measured.minIoU_vs_anchor: 0.318 @f16 — a real stagger, not a twitch
measured.containment_proxy200: TOP 0, LEFT 0, RIGHT 19 @f8 (2 of 97 frames: f8, f14)

hit.qa: PASS, and the strongest anchor-lock in the project so far: 0.997 / 0.995 against the kit anchor. minIoU 0.318 confirms a REAL stagger with genuine body displacement rather than the twitch that defect-only gates reward. Cause-free wording held — nothing enters the frame, no impact flash, and his back is never shown, which is exactly the ir37 node-7 defect this law exists to prevent.
hit.feather_note: FEATHER, not re-roll: RIGHT ~91px real on just 2 of 97 frames (f8, f14). Sampled rgb(89,70,76) / rgb(74,66,65) = dark iron, i.e. the TETSUBO TIP during the recoil — not his body and not debris. The documented test is "body well inside AND only a PROP TIP crosses"; his body scores 0.997, so this is the feather case. Contrast ir37 special_3, rejected at 48-62px because detached PETALS are not a prop tip.
hit.why_hit_second: Chosen as clip 2 deliberately: hit fires nearly every exchange, so it is the most-seen animation in the game, and it is the state whose defect produced Tim's node-7 bug on ir37 (she took the hit with her back turned, needing 5 rolls).

ko.spec: seedance_2_0, 4s, 720p, std, bitrate standard, 1:1, audio off, start_image ONLY (NO end_image — see note), use_unlim (0 credits)

measured.fLast_vs_anchor: 0.249 — CORRECTLY low; ko is off-anchor by spec (ir48 ko = 0.272)
measured.fLast_bbox_aspect: 4.10 (wide and short) — confirms genuinely PRONE, not merely crouched
measured.tail_stability: 0.998 min frame-to-frame IoU over the last 12 frames — comes fully to rest
measured.containment_proxy200: TOP 0, LEFT 0, RIGHT 12 (~58px real). Bottom exempt — he is ON the floor.

ko.qa: PASS on every ko-specific criterion. It starts ON the anchor (0.994) and ends genuinely PRONE — proven by bbox aspect 4.10 (wide/short) rather than by the raw IoU alone, because a low IoU could equally mean a crouch or a mess. Tail stability 0.998 shows he comes to rest and stays there instead of twitching, which is what a KO must do while the round-end holds. Cause-free: nothing enters the frame.
ko.no_end_image_note: end_image was deliberately OMITTED for this clip alone. Every other clip pins start AND end to the standing plate, which is what makes fLast land on the anchor — but a ko MUST end prone, so pinning the last frame to a standing plate would fight the acting. This is the transport-level twin of the KO-SUFFIX RULE.
ko.ko_suffix_verified: build-prompt stripped BOTH contradictions for ko: the weapon-lock ("keeps the tetsubo in his hands ... never drops or swaps") and the anchor-lock ("begins and ends on the EXACT same reference stance"). Verified 0 occurrences of each in the built prompt before firing. Without that the prompt would order him to keep AND drop the club, and to end on the anchor AND end prone.
ko.feather_note: FEATHER not re-roll: RIGHT ~58px is the DROPPED TETSUBO lying on the floor. Prop, not body, and the body is well inside.
ko.debris_fix: The acting line originally said the landing dust "settles", contradicting the vanish law (which is NOT stripped for ko). Changed to "drifting away to nothing" before firing. Fourth instance of that contradiction class this session — phrase-list sweeps only find the phrasings you thought of, and this one wrapped across a line break so even a targeted sed missed it on the first try.

victory.verdict: REJECT v1 — front turn + club fully vertical overhead
victory.qa: REJECTED, and the way it fails is the finding. f42: he is SQUARE TO CAMERA with both pectorals visible. f70: square to camera AND holding the tetsubo FULLY VERTICAL above his own horns. That one frame breaks three locks already present verbatim in its own prompt (club head never above his head / never fully vertical or overhead / the club head goes DOWN, never up). Proof frames: qa-boss/oni/proof/victory-sheet.png and victory-worst.png.
victory.why_the_gates_missed_it: THREE GATES WERE GREEN. Anchor-lock 0.995/0.995 was the project second-best; containment was clean on every edge; body-commitment said ok. Only check-frontturn caught it. anchor-lock reads ONLY f0 and fLast, so it is blind to 95 of 97 frames — and because end_image PINS the last frame to the plate, fLast is now very nearly free on this transport and carries almost no information about the acting. NEVER ACCEPT ON ANCHOR-LOCK + CONTAINMENT AGAIN.
victory.v2_fix: Written and gate-clean in qa-boss/prompts/oni-tetsubo.md. Root cause is an INVERTED TIME BUDGET: three beats did not fill 4s, so the model invented a theatrical turn and a vertical club raise on the unbounded up-verb lifts. v2 explicitly spends the time (first quarter plant / middle half HELD lean + head-only roar with the chin bounded by his own horns / final quarter return bounded to the reference images height). Restating the bans was NOT an option — both were already in the suffix verbatim and were ignored.

next: victory v2 (rewritten), then strikes / throws / blocks, then the 3 specials (EARTHSHAKER / SPIKE DRIVER / OGRE STOMP).
